subject: Request: sandbox extension + one-time evaluation credits for Spotlight AI
messages:
From: Alexei Voronov <alexei@spotlight.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Sandbox trial — procurement delay; request for extension and credits

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the engineers and data team are excited about the latency and cost profiles you showed. We're running into a procurement holdup on our side: legal and security need to finish a short review before we can sign the SOW. That process is likely to take 2–3 weeks.

We started the sandbox last Monday and have already burned through the baseline tokens for the trial. Two asks: 1) can Redwood give us a short bridge (30 days) on the sandbox so our engineers can finish integration testing once legal signs, and 2) a one-time top-up of evaluation credits to avoid interrupting the trial while we wait on procurement?

I attached the updated SOW and a usage snapshot from our side. Spotlight's VP of Product is keen to run a live UX test the week after legal signs — missing that window would push us to a competitor. We believe there's a clear path to a paid pilot and a Q1 production trial if we can keep momentum.

Appreciate any help here. Happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Alexei Voronov
Head of Product
Spotlight AI

Attachments: Spotlight_POC_SOW_v2.pdf, spotlight_usage_dec_report.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 13:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandbox trial — procurement delay; request for extension and credits

That will help me make the case to deal desk and sales leadership. If you can, include the procurement milestone (legal sign date estimate).

I'll follow up internally and loop in Rishi/Vivek for exec sign-off if required.

Talk soon,
Marissa Cole

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Alexei Voronov <alexei@spotlight.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Sandbox trial — procurement delay; request for extension and credits — request for one-off exception

Rishi, Vivek — forwarding a request from Spotlight AI (see below). High-level:
- Account: Spotlight AI (early-stage, product-led evaluation)
- Potential: >$420k ARR in first 12 months if the pilot converts (sales forecast attached in HubSpot)
- Current status: SOW under legal review on their side; they estimate sign in ~2–3 weeks (procurement delay)
- Ask: 30-day sandbox extension + one-time evaluation credit top-up to avoid interruption of integration testing
- Their current monthly burn: ~120k tokens/week based on the attached CSV; they expect peak runs during UX test (estimate additional 220k tokens over two weeks)

What I'm asking for: a constrained exception we can approve quickly to keep the trial active. I recommend:
  1) One-time credit top-up equivalent to 150k tokens (tokens are our internal metric; POC credits = $X equivalent)
  2) 21-day sandbox extension beyond our standard PLG window (not the full 30 requested)
  3) Condition: SOW signed and a pilot check-in scheduled within 21 days of extension start; usage reporting to Marissa weekly

Rationale: Spotlight is product-led but shows clear PLG-to-paid motion; VP Product scheduled a UX test which is a meaningful near-term conversion signal. If we don't keep the trial live they lose the momentum and likely delay purchase by a full quarter.

Attachments: Spotlight_POC_SOW_v2.pdf, spotlight_usage_dec_report.csv (attached by customer). HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/SPOT-2026-0892

Can we approve this as a one-time, non-repeatable exception? If yes, I can get DocuSign addendum in place immediately and amend the sandbox flags.

Thanks — Marissa

--Original message attached below--

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alexei Voronov <alexei@spotlight.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sandbox trial — procurement delay; request for extension and credits — request for one-off exception

Marissa / Vivek — reviewed the ask and supporting usage. Appreciate the compact recommendation. Approve a constrained exception with these firm limits: 

1) One-time evaluation credit top-up equivalent to 150,000 tokens (no further top-ups).
2) Sandbox extension of 21 calendar days from the date we flip the sandbox flag.
3) Conditions before activation: a) customer executes the current SOW or a signed addendum acknowledging the extension; b) a pilot review meeting scheduled within 21 days of extension start (calendar invite to include Marissa/Rishi); c) weekly usage reports to Marissa (to be included in the HubSpot deal record).

Rationale: preserves momentum, limits exposure, and ties release to contractual sign and scheduled milestones. If they convert within the 21-day window we can fast-track a committed pilot and discuss reserved capacity.

Marissa — please confirm you'll handle the DocuSign addendum and that the sandbox flag will be time-limited and non-renewing. Vivek — please advise if you want me on the pilot review call.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
